# create-pantoken-app

> Agent skill that scaffolds a new project with [pantoken](https://pantoken.app) (Instructure UI
> design tokens and icons) already wired in, or adds pantoken to an existing repo. Detects the
> framework, installs the right `@pantoken/*` packages, and wires the token CSS.

- [SKILL.md](https://create.pantoken.app/SKILL.md): the canonical skill file — install via `npx @pantoken/ai scaffold`, or point an agent at this URL directly.

## Related

- [pantoken.app/llms.txt](https://pantoken.app/llms.txt): the full pantoken documentation index.
- [pantoken.app](https://pantoken.app): pantoken documentation and package guides.
